title: Siege of Nuremberg
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Nuremberg", at revision 1370744103, opens: "The siege of Nuremberg was a campaign that took place in 1632 about the Imperial City of Nuremberg during the Thirty Years' War." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q7510280, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "siege in the thirty years' war, 1632". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
